boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner software evidence. No independent reproduction, empirical GMUT, production THOS or Freed ID, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, consciousness, personhood, complete privacy, accessibility or security, AGI, ASI, Theory-of-Everything proof or Stage 20 readiness.
groups: record-shape
Validate a bounded rational discounted decision record.
policy-space
Enumerate the declared deterministic stationary policy space.
policy-evaluation
Compare exact Gaussian and Cramer values for the zero-index policy.
bellman-residual
Check every optimal Bellman residual equals zero.
exhaustive-optimum
Enumerate all deterministic policies and retain every componentwise optimizer.
policy-improvement
Retain policy iteration steps and verify nondecreasing values.
action-values
Compute exact optimal action values and nonpositive advantages.
statewise-regret
Compare each enumerated policy with the optimal value vector.
tie-break
Keep all optimal action ties and choose the least action index.
discounted-occupancy
Solve the discounted state visitation system and check its total mass.
occupancy-duality
Check flow balance and equality of occupancy reward with initial value.
initial-distribution
Check every one-hot initial return against the value vector.
reward-translation
Shift every reward by three and verify the exact value shift.
reward-scaling
Scale every reward by two and verify value covariance.
state-permutation
Reverse state labels and preserve every value after transport.
duplicate-action
Duplicate an action without changing the optimum.
residual-enclosure
Use twelve Bellman updates and an exact contraction residual enclosure.
three-coordinate-model
Represent policy count, synthetic return and iteration count.
calibration-gap
Record missing measured transitions and reward calibration.
deployment-hold
Hold real deployment until its named prerequisites exist.
